models_evaluated: DK-LLM (LangChain agent with local textbook knowledge base)

links.outcome: Exam score on 56 thoracic-surgery questions with versus without local knowledge base
links.effect: Removing the local knowledge base reduced the examination score by 11.8 percentage points; the knowledge-augmented DK-LLM showed an 11.8-point advantage.
links.quote: in the ablation analysis, removing the local knowledge base reduced the examination score by 11.8 percentage points.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluation comparing an LLM agent with and without retrieval-augmented grounding (local medical textbook knowledge base) on thoracic surgery exam questions.

primary.practice: retrieval grounding via local knowledge base
